en.bdb: Man without Guru is the worst

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਿਗੁਰੇ ਲਖ ਨ ਤੁਲ ਤਿਸ ਨਿਗੁਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਿ ਨ ਆਏ।
verses.translit_en: nigure lakh na tul tis nigure satigur saran na aae|

en.bdb: He who comes not in the shelter of the Lord God is incomparable even with millions of persons without Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਪੈ ਆਪਣਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਡਿਠੇ ਨਿਗੁਰੇ ਸਰਮਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: jo gur gopai aapanaa tis ddiThe nigure saramaae|

en.bdb: Even the Guruless people feel shy of seeing the man who talks ill of his Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੀਹ ਸਉਹਾਂ ਜਾਣਾ ਭਲਾ ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਬੇਮੁਖ ਸਉਹਾਂ ਜਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: seeh sauhaa(n) jaanaa bhalaa naa tis bemukh sauhaa(n) jaae|

en.bdb: It is better to face a lion than to meet that renegade man.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਜੋ ਮੁਹੁ ਫਿਰੈ ਤਿਸ ਮੁਹਿ ਲਗਣੁ ਵਡੀ ਬਲਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: satigur te jo muh firai tis muh lagan vaddee balaae|

en.bdb: To deal with a person who turns away from the true Guru is to invite disaster.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਾਰੈ ਧਰਮ ਹੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਨ ਹੰਘੈ ਆਪੁ ਹਟਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: jo tis maarai dharam hai maar na ha(n)ghai aap haTaae|

en.bdb: To kill such a person is a righteous act. If that cannot be done then one should oneself move away.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੁਆਮਿ ਧੋਹੀ ਅਕ੍ਰਿਤਘਣ ਬਾਮਣ ਗਊ ਵਿਸਾਹਿ ਮਰਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: suaam dhohee akirataghan baaman guoo visaeh maraae|

en.bdb: Ungrateful person betrays his master and treacherously kills brahmins and cows.
Such renegade is not. equal in value to one trichome.
